message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0 to 3**.  
Here’s the full breakdown:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | \( \frac{1}{8} \) (12.5 %) |
| 1     | \( \frac{3}{8} \) (37.5 %) |
| 2     | \( \frac{3}{8} \) (37.5 %) |
| 3     | \( \frac{1}{8} \) (12.5 %) |

So you can get 0, 1, 2, or 3 heads, with the probabilities shown above.
